scope: Explicit native shared rich-language V2 foundation: separate causal model/journal, structural projection, code typing/conversion/language and task completion. Browser/relay V2 factories and the complete structural command family are not implemented. Existing installed V1 collaboration is regression-tested against the rebuilt application runtime.

contracts.original: Original rich-language V1 factories and direct RichReplica constructors remain model 11/journal 12. V1 descriptors and genesis operations are unchanged. Document format 2 and local checkpoint format 1 retain their meanings.
contracts.nativeOptIn: SharedRichProfile::from_schema_v2, from_configuration_json_v2 and from_standard_configuration_json_v2 explicitly select rich language 2, causal model 12 and journal 13. Configuration format 2 retains bounded closed declarations and tightening-only host limits. There is no automatic migration.
contracts.binding: Compiled profile selects the protocol. V2 genesis has a causal model marker checked against the compiled profile before projection/adoption. Framed updates, authenticated writer groups, semantic lineage and presence derive their versions from that owner; wrong framed versions reject before opaque import. Raw engine updates are staged and validate their causal marker before publication.
contracts.projection: Code owns causal text, not recursively interpreted text children. Quotes, task lists/items and rules retain structural identities. Empty task lists hide; missing task prose heads and empty quotes use deterministic normalized prose. Existing nested-table and image-caption grammar remains in force.
contracts.code: Explicit rejectFormatted/removeFormats policy. Observed style removal authors writer-owned disables; code projection masks unseen concurrent styles. Prose conversion disables currently observed latent styles without deleting their foreign contributions. Kind and language fields have independent causal ownership. Unicode, tabs and LF/CR are exact; nonempty pending code styles reject.
contracts.taskCompletion: Explicit Boolean completion with a true no-op for the matching value. Author-local Undo preserves another writer's completion and body edits.
contracts.sequentialGroups: Target kinds follow earlier conversions in the same atomic batch. Code conversion followed by language changes is one history group; a later invalid format rejects the complete batch without publication.
contracts.browserSurface: Application Wasm still exports the existing five JavaScript exports and 51 raw Wasm exports. No V2 Wasm profile factory or SDK/relay selector is exposed. Default browser archive is unchanged.
